description: This TypeScript source file defines functions and report modules for analyzing and formatting topology reports related to a project. It includes utilities for extracting export names, generating symbols, formatting records, and describing various report types such as public surface usage, owner mapping, single-owner shared exports, unused public surface, and consumer topology.
